## Load Data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Update the path and filename, then uncomment to load your data.
# data <- read.csv("data/your-file.csv")
nhanes <- read_csv(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

glimpse(nhanes)
```

## Data Cleaning
```{r}
r_summary <- nhanes |>
  filter(!is.na(IncomeGroup), !is.na(Gender))
r_summary
```

## Descriptive BMI Summary
```{r}
bmi_summary <- r_summary |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup, Gender) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(BMI)),
    n_missing_bmi = sum(is.na(BMI)),
    mean_bmi = round(mean(BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_bmi = round(sd(BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_bmi = round(median(BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    iqr_bmi = round(IQR(BMI, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bmi_summary
```
